core_obligations: Reduce by the criterion: it suffices to show that the trace of a retrocompact open of the ambient space is retrocompact in the open subspace (proof lines 2836-2839)

Test on quasi-compact opens: a quasi-compact open of the subspace is quasi-compact and open in the ambient space as well, so the trace of the retrocompact open is quasi-compact (proof lines 2840-2845)
proof_roadmap: 由「可构造 ⟺ 逆像 retrocompact」的判据，只需证 V ∩ U 在 U 中 retrocompact（V 在 X 中 retrocompact 开）。
任取 U 中的准紧开 W：它也是 X 中的准紧开 ⇒ V ∩ W = V ∩ U ∩ W 准紧（V 在 X 中 retrocompact）。
